purpose: Use the exact global root number of the q=84/13 model38 elliptic quotient together with the proven 2-parity theorem and the already exact 2-Selmer/torsion bounds. This is independent of the external higher-descent gateway path.

theorem_adapter.two_isogeny_hypothesis: E(K)[2] is nonzero; in fact the exact torsion invariants are [2,2].
theorem_adapter.two_parity_statement: For an elliptic curve over a number field with a K-rational point of order 2, the 2-parity theorem gives (-1)^(rk_2(E/K)) = w(E/K), where rk_2 is the Z_2-corank of the 2-infinity Selmer group.
sources: Česnavičius, The p-parity conjecture for elliptic curves with a p-isogeny; p<=3 cases are established
theorem_adapter.selmer_upper_bound: The Kummer exact sequence gives dim Sel_2(E/K) = rank(E(K)) + dim E(K)[2] + dim Sha(E/K)[2]. The divisible (Q_2/Z_2)^delta part contributes delta dimensions to Sha[2], hence rk_2=rank+delta <= dim Sel_2 - dim E[2] = 3-2 = 1.
theorem_adapter.decision: If exact RootNumber(E38)=+1, 2-parity forces rk_2 even. Since 0<=rk_2<=1, rk_2=0 and therefore rank(E38)=0. If RootNumber(E38)=-1, parity forces rk_2=1 but does not distinguish Mordell-Weil rank 0 from 1, so no rank closure follows.

root_number_contract: Magma V2.29 RootNumber(E) for elliptic curves over number fields computes the product of local root numbers over all places. This is an exact integer +/-1 computation; AnalyticRank is not used.
rank_transfer_scope: If model38 rank zero is proven, the existing exact Q(i)-conjugate-scaling certificate transfers rank zero to model165. It does not transfer the rational quotient-X condition or parent pullback.
credit: PREAUDIT rank candidate only if root number is +1 and all exact sanity checks return. No branch/sign-partner or receiver authority changes without deterministic adapter replay, rational-X/parent classification, and hostile audit.
